STATUS

Acceptance requires all twelve cohort cases evaluated for the exact candidate and at least eleven passes (J02). Even a B4 pass would leave C1 at ten passes, below threshold.

J06’s nine-of-nine export selects successful examples, hiding failures and missing evaluation; its cropped heading does not change validation. C2’s B3 pass on Day 8 is its only outcome and cannot replace C1’s B3 failure (J08, J12).

NEXT

A8 repair remains merely proposed. Recover authoritative case totals and version boundaries from J04–J05, J08, and J12.
